many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only

# Continual ARC

Do not interpret an unchanged demo as evidence for a transformation, or assume a panel is recolored wholesale merely because it resembles the test. Keep hypotheses distinct until examples discriminate them.
3. Request a demo only when a specific unresolved distinction could change the answer and another pair can resolve it; count it against the same cost as a wrong submission. Before requesting, state internally what competing rules it will distinguish. Stop requesting once evidence resolves the mapping; don't use demos as generic exploration.
